preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 3 and 70, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each integer in the second line is between 1 and n, inclusive.
preconditions.description: The initial positions of the stones are valid vertices on the polygon.

preconditions.expression: The matrix is symmetric and contains only lowercase English letters and '*'.
preconditions.description: The matrix represents the colors of the diagonals correctly.

postconditions.expression: Output is either -1 or a sequence of moves.
postconditions.description: The output indicates whether a solution exists and, if so, the sequence of moves to achieve the goal.

postconditions.expression: If output is not -1, the number of moves is minimal.
postconditions.description: The solution with the minimum number of moves is provided.

postconditions.expression: Each move is valid and corresponds to a diagonal of the same color connecting two stones.
postconditions.description: The moves are legal and maintain the color constraint.

invariants.expression: The goal is to move stones to vertices 1, 2, and 3.
invariants.description: The objective is to position the stones on the specified vertices with the minimal number of moves.

invariants.expression: The matrix is used to determine valid moves based on diagonal colors.
invariants.description: The color information on the diagonals is crucial for deciding the next move.
